items.phrase: Did you have a good weekend?
items.example: Did you have a good weekend? — Not bad, thanks.
How was your weekend? — It was great.
What did you do at the weekend?
Where did you go? — We went to the beach.
Who did you go with? — With my sister and two friends.
You didn't like the film? Why was that?
Did you go swimming? — Me too!
What did you do on Sunday? — Nothing special.
You walked ten miles? That sounds awful!
How was your weekend? — Not bad.
Find three things that you both did.
